texts.title_text: London Fashion Week's conclusion ignited a push to diversify the industry beyond London's dominance.
texts.slide_1_text: The British Fashion Council announced plans to integrate regional talent across the UK into the fashion calendar.
texts.slide_2_text: Organizers will host pop-up events in England, Wales, and Scotland this season, with Northern Ireland joining next year.
texts.slide_3_text: A House of Commons report confirmed over half of the creative industries' economic impact comes from outside London.
texts.slide_4_text: Industry experts argue this strategy could unlock opportunities for designers in smaller communities.
